mailAsk for a quote with these numbers

An indicative calculation made in your browser with the figures you enter and an assumed automation share (50% by default, not measured in your company). It is not an offer, a guarantee or a promise of savings: the real result depends on your processes. All figures are in the currency you choose, with no conversion. One full-time person counts as 160 hours a month.

Questions

AxisWorks ERP: frequently asked questions

Can modules be added or removed later?expand_more
Yes. Every module shares the same database as the rest, so adding one later means no migration. Inside the company, each tool can also be granted or removed per person.
How do we load the data we already have in Excel?expand_more
Inventory is imported from CSV on its own screen. Clients, open contracts and the rest are reviewed case by case during setup.
Who sees what inside the company?expand_more
Management sees everything. A sales agent sees their own leads, their own deals and the projects assigned to them. The database enforces that separation, not just the screen.
Where is my data?expand_more
In a PostgreSQL database of your own, managed on Supabase, with row-level security and backups. This demo does not touch any real database: everything you see is sample data.
